preconditions.description: The length of array a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= i for i, ai in enumerate(a, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each element ai in array a satisfies 0 <= ai <= i.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i+1] for i in range(n-1))

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(0 <= bi <= 10**6 for bi in b))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or an array b of length n with each element in the range [0, 10^6].

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(mex(b[:i+1]) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', then for each i (1 <= i <= n), the MEX of the first i elements of b is equal to ai.
